jobs.title: Chef de Rang (fixed-term)
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 31 offices in financial centers worldwide, currently employing more than 5’000 people. The group is owned and managed by eight partners and stands out as a company with an entrepreneurial spirit and loyalty. Pictet has been present in Zurich since 1982 where it employs over 200 people. The Zurich branch is located at the Leuenhof, one of the most historic buildings on the prestigious Bahnhofstrasse.

We are looking for a passionate Chef de Rang to join our team in Zurich. As a key member of our motivated team, you will be working for Food & Beverage activities, in our beautiful premises in the heart of Zurich.
You will bring your communication skills, your ability to work independently and your good knowledge of foreign languages to a service-oriented team that will appreciate your motivation, high quality standards and networked thinking. Your organizational skills and thoughtful approach to your work will enable you to maintain an overview even in hectic situations. You will use your sense of responsibility, pleasant manner and outstanding client focus to support our own staff as well as our clients.

Your role

You will manage the activities of the restaurant dedicated to the Bank's clients and management, as well as external and internal events (banquets and catering). You will be the main contact for the kitchen and reception teams and coordinate and perform all the Food & Beverage activities. As a Food & Beverage Coordinator you provide a first-class Food & Beverage service with the emphasis on quality and always maintain absolute discretion.

Your responsibilities include the following:
• Plan and organize client lunches and hospitality service with or without external catering service
• Ensure the setting up of lounges or banquets according to the reservation forecasts and menus
• Take orders and propose food and wine pairings, if necessary
• Manage the wine cellar in coordination with Geneva’s F&B team
• Monitor the service and ensure its excellence
• Help to prepare client-facing events
• Ensure the maintenance of the material (silverware, glasses...), as well as its inventory
• Perform general administrative duties
• Participate in the establishment and improvement of standards and procedures

Your profile

• Hotel management training/apprenticeship
• At least 5 years of experience in a high-end hospitality environment or in a successful running restaurant
• Native German speaker, fluent in English and knowledge of French would be an advantage
• Service-oriented, smart and confident appearance
• Must be resident in Switzerland

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

La tua squadra Il gruppo Pictet è uno dei principali asset manager indipendenti al mondo. Fondato nel 1805 e con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, il Gruppo è rappresentato in 31 uffici nei centri finanziari di tutto il mondo, attualmente impiegando oltre 5’000 persone. Il gruppo è di proprietà e gestito da otto partner e si distingue come azienda con spirito imprenditoriale e lealtà. Pictet è presente a Zurigo dal 1982 dove impiega oltre 200 persone. La filiale di Zurigo si trova al Leuenhof, uno degli edifici più storici della prestigiosa Bahnhofstrasse. Stiamo cercando un appassionato Chef de Rang per unirsi al nostro team a Zurigo. In qualità di membro chiave del nostro team motivato, lavorerai per le attività Food & Beverage, nella nostra bella sede nel cuore di Zurigo. Porterai le tue capacità di comunicazione, la tua capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e la tua buona conoscenza delle lingue straniere a un team orientato al servizio che apprezzerà la tua motivazione, gli standard di alta qualità e il pensiero in rete. Le tue capacità organizzative e l'approccio riflessivo al tuo lavoro ti consentiranno di mantenere una panoramica anche in situazioni frenetiche. Userete il vostro senso di responsabilità, modo piacevole e l'attenzione cliente eccezionale per sostenere il nostro personale così come i nostri clienti. Il tuo ruolo Potrai gestire le attività del ristorante dedicato ai clienti e alla gestione della Banca, nonché eventi esterni e interni (banquet e catering). Sarete il contatto principale per i team di cucina e reception e coordinare e svolgere tutte le attività Food & Beverage. Come Coordinatore Food & Beverage fornisci un servizio di prima classe Food & Beverage con l'accento sulla qualità e mantieni sempre assoluta discrezione. Le tue responsabilità includono:
• Pianificare e organizzare pranzi cliente e servizio di ospitalità con o senza servizio di catering esterno
• Assicurare la creazione di saloni o banchetti secondo le previsioni e i menu di prenotazione
• Prendere ordini e proporre abbinamenti di cibo e vino, se necessario
• Gestire la cantina in coordinamento con il team F&B di Ginevra
• Monitorare il servizio e garantire la sua eccellenza
• Aiutare a preparare gli eventi client

• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza in un ambiente di ospitalità di fascia alta o in un ristorante di successo
• Altoparlante tedesco nativo, fluente in inglese e conoscenza del francese sarebbe un vantaggio

Ihr Team Die Pictet Gruppe ist einer der weltweit führenden unabhängigen Vermögens- und Vermögensverwalter. 1805 gegründet und mit Sitz in Genf, Schweiz, ist die Gruppe in 31 Büros in Finanzzentren weltweit vertreten und beschäftigt derzeit mehr als 5’000 Mitarbeiter. Die Gruppe ist im Besitz und verwaltet von acht Partnern und steht als Unternehmen mit Unternehmergeist und Loyalität. Pictet ist seit 1982 in Zürich vertreten und beschäftigt über 200 Mitarbeiter. Die Zürcher Filiale befindet sich am Leuenhof, einem der historischen Gebäude der renommierten Bahnhofstrasse. Wir suchen einen leidenschaftlichen Chef de Rang, der unserem Team in Zürich beitritt. Als zentrales Mitglied unseres motivierten Teams arbeiten Sie in unseren schönen Räumlichkeiten im Herzen von Zürich für Food & Beverage-Aktivitäten. Sie bringen Ihre Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Ihre Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und Ihr gutes Wissen über Fremdsprachen an ein serviceorientiertes Team, das Ihre Motivation, hohe Qualitätsstandards und vernetztes Denken schätzen wird. Ihre organisatorischen Fähigkeiten und einfühlsame Herangehensweise an Ihre Arbeit ermöglichen es Ihnen, einen Überblick auch in hektischen Situationen zu erhalten. Sie nutzen Ihr Verantwortungsgefühl, Ihre angenehme Art und Ihren hervorragenden Kundenfokus, um unser eigenes Personal sowie unsere Kunden zu unterstützen. Ihre Rolle Sie leiten die Aktivitäten des Restaurants, das den Kunden und dem Management der Bank gewidmet ist, sowie externe und interne Veranstaltungen (Bankette und Catering). Sie sind der Hauptkontakt für die Küchen- und Empfangsteams und koordinieren und führen alle Aktivitäten im Bereich Food & Beverage durch. Als Food & Beverage Coordinator bieten Sie einen erstklassigen Food & Beverage-Service mit dem Schwerpunkt auf Qualität und stets absolute Diskretion. Ihre Aufgaben umfassen:
• Planen und organisieren Sie mit oder ohne externen Catering-Service Kundenessen und Gastfreundschaft
• Stellen Sie die Einrichtung von Lounges oder Bankette nach den Reservierungsvorausschätzungen und Menüs sicher
• Bestellungen übernehmen und Lebensmittel- und Weinpaarungen vorschlagen, falls erforderlich
• Den Weinkeller in Abstimmung mit dem F&B-Team von Genf verwalten
• Überwachen Sie den Service und gewährleisten Sie seine Exzellenz
• Hilfe bei der Vorbereitung von Client-Ansichtsveranstaltungen
• Gewährleistung der Wartung des Materials (Silberware, Gläser...), sowie seine Inventar
• Durchführung allgemeiner Verwaltungsaufgaben
• Beteiligung an der Einrichtung und Verbesserung von Normen und Verfahren Ihr Profil
• Hotelmanagement-Ausbildung/Ausbildung
• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer gehobenen Gastfreundschaft oder in einem erfolgreichen Restaurant
• Nativer deutscher Sprecher, fließend in Englisch und Französischkenntnisse wäre ein Vorteil

Vous apporterez vos compétences en communication, votre capacité à travailler de manière indépendante et votre bonne connaissance des langues étrangères à une équipe orientée vers le service qui appréciera votre motivation, vos normes de qualité élevées et votre pensée en réseau. Vous serez le contact principal pour les équipes de cuisine et de réception et coordonner et exécuter toutes les activités Food & Beverage. En tant que coordonnateur des aliments et des boissons, vous offrez un service de première qualité en mettant l'accent sur la qualité et gardez toujours une discrétion absolue. • Planifier et organiser des déjeuners et des services d'accueil avec ou sans service de restauration externe
• Assurer la mise en place de salons ou banquets selon les prévisions de réservation et les menus
• Prendre des commandes et proposer des accords de nourriture et de vin, si nécessaire
• Gérer la cave en coordination avec l'équipe F&B de Genève
• Surveiller le service et assurer son excellence
• Aide à la préparation d'événements destinés aux clients
• Assurer la maintenance du matériel (argenterie, verres...) ainsi que son inventaire
• Exécuter des tâches administratives générales
• Participer à l'établissement et à l'amélioration des normes et des procédures Votre profil
• Formation/apprentissage en gestion d'hôtel
• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans un environnement d'accueil haut de gamme ou dans un restaurant prospère
• Locuteur natif allemand, parlant couramment l'anglais et connaissant le français serait un avantage

jobs.title: Trainee Client Register (12 months)
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.

By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Start date: ASAP
Duration: 12 months
Employment rate: Full-time or Part-time (80% - 1 school day per week)
Prerequisite : a tripartite internship agreement signed with your school

Your role

• Actively participate in client data remediation plan within the bank’s secure environment, specifically in the client repository.

• Understand account lifecycle processes and perform codifications in accordance with established procedures.

• Work closely with team members and key stakeholders such as Front Office, Compliance, and Legal departments.

• Contribute to the update and improvement of internal procedures.

• Take part in various projects and initiatives aimed at optimizing client data management and supporting the continuous improvement of operational processes.

Your profile

• Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field.

• Meticulous, detail-oriented, and organized, delivering work of the highest quality.

• Dynamic, proactive in problem-solving, and demonstrates an entrepreneurial spirit.

• Able to meet deadlines, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple assignments simultaneously.

• Proficient in standard MS Office products.

• Interest in automation, digitalization, and new technologies, with the ability to design, maintain, or improve automated operational tools (Python, SQL, low-code, LLMs, AI agents, etc.), while adhering to security and compliance standards is a strong asset.

• Discreet and able to handle sensitive and confidential information with the utmost professionalism.

• Fluent in written and spoken French; good command of English. German is an asset.

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Nous maîtrisons en interne chaque dimension de l’asset servicing et concevons des solutions sur mesure, telles que des outils analytiques à valeur ajoutée, des supports à l’élaboration de stratégies de trading et des interfaces utilisateurs, pour offrir une expérience client inégalée.

Votre rôle

- Etre le contact principal pour un portefeuille de gérants indépendants (GI).
- Offrir un support et résoudre les problèmes pour toutes les thématiques opérationnelles et administratives.
- Participer au processus administratif de mise en place des relations GI et de leurs comptes clients, en collaboration avec les chargés de relations (CRM).
- Traiter les opérations de paiement et de transfert, en veillant à ce que les appels de vérification (call-back) soient effectués de manière systématique, et fournir un soutien pour les autres types de transactions, selon les besoins.
- Traiter les demandes (codifications clients internes, cartes de crédit, limites de crédit, conditions spéciales, etc.) et effectuer les saisies dans les workflows correspondants.
- Gérer le flux documentaire (archivage, traitement des formulaires physiques et électroniques).
- Bien connaître les principaux partenaires internes, établir avec eux d’étroites relations et être leur interlocuteur/trice de référence pour le portefeuille.
- Veiller à ce que la prise des appels téléphoniques soit assurée au sein de l’équipe et fournir un soutien pour les tâches administratives.
- Appliquer les politiques et directives en vigueur et accompagner la mise en œuvre de nouvelles règles.

- Formation bancaire ou jugée équivalente.

Your team

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment specialist and wholly owned subsidiary of the Pictet Group, with expertise in hedge funds, private equity and global real estate. With teams based around the world, the PAA teams construct, manage and advise on portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients.

The Group has strong growth ambitions for PAA for the years ahead, notably to expand its product offering to include additional asset classes and to further develop its institutional client base.

Based in Geneva, you will become part of a dynamic five-person team on a six-month temporary contract, assisting with a rise in workload and activity. Your role will involve offering operational support for both hedge fund portfolios and managed accounts.

Your role

• Managing and coordinating operations linked to PAA’s hedge fund products and mandates (NAV calculations, reporting, transactions and client services).
• Providing support to the investment teams, management and internal clients.
• Coordinating with all service providers (legal, tax, compliance, administrators, back office, etc.).
• Monitoring risks and investment constraints.
• Working on various occasional and recurrent projects (e.g. TER calculations).

Your profile

• At least five years’ experience in a similar role in a fund department or with an asset manager.
• Proven practical knowledge of hedge fund operations management.
• Rigorous, with excellent numeracy skills and a keen attention to detail.
• A certain ability to deal with issues/topics with specialists from various businesses (investment managers, tax, compliance, etc.), with excellent verbal and writing skills in these particular situations.
• Advanced user of Excel and generally at ease with new IT systems. Use of Webfolio is a plus.
• At ease expressing yourself in both French and English, with the relevant written proficiency to draft documentation and discuss complex matters with both internal and external parties, whether native speakers or not.
• A strong interest in and/or experience with AI would be an asset.
• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

Note

jobs.title: Publishing Officer
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience.

The role of the function is to ensure the smooth running of the publishing production according to the SLAs, deadlines and roadmaps in place for in-house and third-party funds. A high level of client support (internal and external) will be expected.

Your role

• Code request as part of fund launch process (LEI, Bloomberg Tickers, etc…).

• Set up, control / update of static and dynamic data.

• Contribute to the efficient and accurate execution of publishing operations.

• Activate and publish request according to registration status.

• Disseminate legal fund documentations, monthly portfolio reports and No NAV calculation reports.

• Manage the chargeback of invoices.

• Collect and organize documents.

• Scan and archive documents and data.

Your profile

Knowledge /Technical skills:

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics or related

• 2-year experience in banking sector

• Good knowledge in fund operations, process and data analysis

• In-depth knowledge of MS Office and banking softwares (Multifonds, Luxis and Avaloq)

• Excellent knowledge of operational banking and legal perspective for funds

• Good knowledge in Python programming and being at ease with the use of AI Tools would be considered as distinguishing factors.

Soft skills:

• Rigor

• Attention to detail

• Organizational skills

• Team spirit

• Problem solving abilities

Language skills

• Fluent in french and english

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Votre équipe

La division Corporate Functions regroupe les activités non bancaires du groupe Pictet et compte plus de 800 collaborateurs. Composées de spécialistes maîtrisant parfaitement l’ensemble des lignes de métier, les fonctions centrales s’articulent autour de plusieurs départements: Audit interne, Communication, Compliance, Corporate Office, Finances, Fiscalité, Juridique, Ressources humaines, Risques et Sécurité de l’information.

Basé à Genève, le département Group Tax a pour mission de gérer la situation fiscale du Groupe, en assurant la conformité avec les exigences légales et réglementaires, la gestion des risques fiscaux, la préservation de la réputation de Pictet et le maintien de relations de qualité avec les administrations fiscales.

Group Tax cherche un/e expert/e en fiscalité pour intégrer l’équipe Group Tax Office , chargée principalement du pilotage de projets fiscaux stratégiques au sein du Groupe, de la gestion des risques et des contrôles fiscaux, ainsi que de la coordination en cas de demandes de renseignements ou d’audits.

Votre rôle

• Participer au pilotage des projets fiscaux stratégiques, en apportant votre expertise sur les impôts directs et indirects (impôt anticipé, TVA, droit de timbre), les taxes transactionnelles et l’imposition à la source.

• Mettre en place et réaliser des contrôles et audits fiscaux, formuler des recommandations et suivre leur mise en œuvre.

• Évaluer les risques fiscaux et élaborer des stratégies de mitigation.

• Superviser les processus de classification et de reporting client pour garantir la conformité aux exigences FATCA, CRS et QI, dans le cadre de la transparence fiscale.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les autres départements pour intégrer les aspects fiscaux dans les projets transverses.

• Suivre l’évolution du droit et de la réglementation en matière de fiscalité.

Votre profil

• Diplôme universitaire en droit ou en sciences économiques.

• Expérience de 5 à 10 ans en fiscalité, idéalement acquise en cabinet d’avocats ou dans l’une des « Big Four ».

• Capacité à travailler de manière autonome, en faisant preuve d’esprit d’initiative.

• Excellentes compétences analytiques, sens de la résolution de problèmes et capacité à proposer des améliorations aux pratiques actuelles.

• Maîtrise des applications MS Office usuelles.

• Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais ; la connaissance de l’allemand est un atout.

Réf. GTE/LJ/VB

Note

Nous n’accepterons aucun CV transmis par des agences.

Diversité & Inclusion

Pictet est un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances et s’engage à créer un environnement diversifié. Nous respectons chaque individu et veillons à favoriser leur inclusion au sein de l’entreprise.

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.

By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Your role

• Monitoring of the team mailbox and allocation of queries;

• Handling Beneficial Owner monitoring requests;

• Preparation of clients due diligence and audits visits;

• Handling reporting’s register related questions;

• Assisting on general mailings to investors;

• Archiving investor documents;

• Communicating professionally with internal and external clients.

Your profile

• A Master's in Finance, Economics or Engineering.

• A first experience, in the field of AML/KYC and/or a Compliance function.

• Good knowledge of the funds industry and the different stakeholders involved.

• Written and spoken fluency in French and English.

• Meticulous, detail oriented and organized with highest quality deliveries.

• Able to meet deadlines, prioritise and multi-task

• Ability to communicate clearly and promptly

Experience in the following would be a major advantage:

• At first experience working with the account opening or ongoing due diligence processes.

• Knowledge of Luxembourg AML/KYC regulations; knowledge of the different roles in the investment fund industry (asset management, custodian bank, transfer agent and fund administration) as well as of the related regulatory framework.

• Any FATCA/CRS experience or knowledge.

• ACAMS certification or equivalent.

• Experience using AML tools (World-Check, Pythagoras, Factiva) and public sources (RBE, Signature.net).

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Your team

At Pictet, our Technology and Operations divisions work in close partnership to deliver innovative, secure, and efficient solutions that drive the Group’s success. The Technology division develops and integrates advanced software solutions, such as portfolio management systems, trading platforms, and banking applications – playing a key role in the Group’s digital transformation and client value creation. The Operations division ensures the secure and efficient processing of banking transactions and investment funds, maintaining regulatory compliance and managing operational risks to support the reliability of our financial services.

Together, Technology and Operations form the backbone of Pictet’s ability to deliver outstanding client experiences, playing a key role in the Group’s digital transformation and value creation.

You will be part of the Finance Pictet Tech & Operations team. The team plays a pivotal role in the financial steering of the division, by providing timely, relevant financial data and reports in aligning financial strategies with business objectives and delivering actionable insights to stakeholders.

Your role

As a member of the Finance Tech & Operations team, you will own the development of financial dashboards, manage finance analytical data models, automate reporting production processes, and act as the primary Finance liaison with the Central Data Engineering team. You will contribute to both the operational continuity of financial processes and the longer-term transformation of Finance analytics within Pictet Technology and Operations.

• Ensure data consistency and integrity across finance reporting layers and upstream data pipelines.
• Develop and manage the finance analytical data model, ensuring it accurately reflects latest analytical views.
• Drive the automation of finance data production and reporting processes, eliminating manual workflows and enhancing the reliability and frequency of financial reporting.
• Design, build, and maintain financial dashboards covering P&L by product, cost allocation, and operational KPIs aligned with new operating model.
• Support FP&A and management accounting activities with robust, scalable analytics.

Your profile

• Master’s degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field.
• 3-5 years of experience as a data analyst – experience collaborating with finance teams is a plus.
• Strong proficiency in SQL, python, and experience with visualisation tools.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical (Data Engineering) and business (Finance) stakeholders.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently.
• Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and tools.
• Resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

Ref. : FDA/CC/FAA

Diversity & Inclusion

Your team At Pictet, our Technology and Operations divisions work in close partnership to deliver innovative, secure, and efficient solutions that drive the Group’s success. The Technology division develops and integrates advanced software solutions, such as portfolio management systems, trading platforms, and banking applications – playing a key role in the Group’s digital transformation and client value creation. The Operations division ensures the secure and efficient processing of banking transactions and investment funds, maintaining regulatory compliance and managing operational risks to support the reliability of our financial services. Together, Technology and Operations form the backbone of Pictet’s ability to deliver outstanding client experiences, playing a key role in the Group’s digital transformation and value creation. You will be part of the Finance Pictet Tech & Operations team. The team plays a pivotal role in the financial steering of the division, by providing timely, relevant financial data and reports in aligning financial strategies with business objectives and delivering actionable insights to stakeholders. Your role As a member of the Finance Tech & Operations team, you will own the development of financial dashboards, manage finance analytical data models, automate reporting production processes, and act as the primary Finance liaison with the Central Data Engineering team. You will contribute to both the operational continuity of financial processes and the longer-term transformation of Finance analytics within Pictet Technology and Operations.
• Ensure data consistency and integrity across finance reporting layers and upstream data pipelines.
• Develop and manage the finance analytical data model, ensuring it accurately reflects latest analytical views.
• Drive the automation of finance data production and reporting processes, eliminating manual workflows and enhancing the reliability and frequency of financial reporting.
• Design, build, and maintain financial dashboards covering P&L by product, cost allocation, and operational KPIs aligned with new operating model.
• Support FP&A and management accounting activities with robust, scalable analytics. Your profile
• Master’s degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field.
• 3-5 years of experience as a data analyst – experience collaborating with finance teams is a plus.
• Strong proficiency in SQL, python, and experience with visualisation tools.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical (Data Engineering) and business (Finance) stakeholders.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently.
• Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and tools.
• Resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies.
